rationale.provenance-auditability: Persistent graph links AI changes, structural claims, rationale, evidence, and provenance.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Agent throughput outpaces humans' ability to inspect increasingly large changes.
rationale.oversight-theater: Opaque diffs progressively reduce human review to rubber-stamping.
rationale.quality-debt: Focally addresses code incomprehensibility, regressions, and structural fragility.
rationale.ai-review: Agent-executed rehydration infers candidate structures and detects unsupported claims.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Tests, static analysis, drift thresholds, and structural contracts ground detection.
rationale.risk-routing: High entropy and thresholded divergence trigger checks or human clarification.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Humans retain defined commit-or-rollback authority over every proposed consensus change.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Task-relevant graph projections expose commitments, consequences, evidence, and alternatives.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Alignment and round-trip monitoring detect departures from intent and agreed structure.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes claims that better models alone eliminate oversight needs.
rationale.framework: Specifies a reusable consensus-layer architecture with synchronization and review components.
rationale.design-only: Provides buildable architecture and metrics but only illustrative, unevaluated scenarios.
rationale.agentic: Targets autonomous multi-step agents delivering artifact-level changes through review gates.
rationale.steering: Consensus structure substantively shapes agent planning and generated artifact realization.
rationale.metrics: Defines comprehensibility and quality metrics: fidelity, entropy, intervention distance, cognitive load.
rationale.risk-quality: Focally treats comprehensibility, regressions, causal validity, and structural fragility.
